title: How Wrong Is VERITASIUM? A Lamp and Power Line Story
summary: ElectroBOOM's Mehdi Sadaghdar responds to Veritasium's lamp-and-long-wire puzzle, analysing it as an electrical engineer. He covers where the original framing misleads and the role of stray capacitance.
why: HN commenters recommend it as the more rigorous, polite and complete treatment of the Veritasium puzzle, though one dissents that the original misleads people.

quote.text: Let me highly recommend Mehdi Sadaghdar’s (ElectroBOOM) excellent response video
